conventions.byte_strings: Every *_hex field is lowercase hex without separators.
conventions.errors: name is the snake_case IggyError name and code its numeric code.
conventions.never_returned_keys: No response, decoded projection or accessor may contain these keys or their values.
conventions.option_maps: Option maps use the HTTP JSON form: value as reversible text, kind, and explicit provenance. Request blocks mark every entry explicit.
conventions.options_block_order: Options block entries are encoded in ascending key byte order.
conventions.request_bodies: body_hex and update_resource_hex are command payloads without framing. constants.command_codes maps each command to its code and VSR operation.
conventions.reset_order: The typed encoders and the HTTP handler write reset keys in ascending key byte order.
conventions.stream_state: state is the stored server state a stream response was projected from. SDKs need only response_hex and expected.
conventions.u64_values: u64 option values and typed u64 inputs are decimal strings, so values above 2^53 keep their precision.
